reason: A DeepSeek Harness conversation mode and skill pack that coordinates a virtual product team through product discovery, planning, implementation, QA, release preparation, and later iteration with user approval between stages.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的虚拟产品团队模式，引导用户从想法验证、需求与技术规划到开发、测试、发布及后续迭代。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness virtual product team mode that guides users from idea validation and requirements through planning, development, testing, release preparation, and iteration.

capabilities: Guides users through a staged product-development workflow
Coordinates product definition, technical planning, implementation, testing, and release preparation
May use shell-level tools for development and DSH-specific authoring when explicitly requested
Can prepare promotion, operations, and iteration plans
